description: The note colour palette, in picker order. index is the position in NOTE_COLOR_OPTIONS on both clients; keyword is what the color: search operator accepts; name is the spoken / displayed name (English, the native strings.xml value); light and dark are the stored ARGB for each theme, as unsigned 0xAARRGGBB. Index 0 is no colour: ARGB 0, rendered as the theme's surface. A note whose stored colour is missing (cloud row or backup without a color field) is read as noColor.
